mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'SUBMITTED' THEN 1 END) AS submittedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 END) AS inProgressCount FROM participations WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
SELECT question_id AS questionId, COUNT(*) AS answeredCount FROM answers WHERE event_id = #{eventId} GROUP BY question_id

SELECT qo.question_id AS questionId, qo.id AS optionId, qo.option_text AS optionText, qo.is_other AS isOther, COUNT(ao.id) AS selectedCount FROM event_questions eq INNER JOIN question_options qo ON qo.question_id = eq.id LEFT JOIN answer_options ao ON ao.question_option_id = qo.id AND ao.question_id = qo.question_id WHERE eq.event_id = #{eventId} GROUP BY eq.id, eq.sort_order, qo.id, qo.question_id, qo.option_text, qo.is_other, qo.sort_order ORDER BY eq.sort_order ASC, eq.id ASC, qo.sort_order ASC, qo.id ASC
SELECT question_id AS questionId, rating_value AS ratingValue, COUNT(*) AS ratingCount FROM answers WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND rating_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY question_id, rating_value

SELECT t.questionId, t.textValue FROM ( SELECT a.question_id AS questionId, COALESCE(a.answer_text, a.other_text) AS textValue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.question_id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC ) AS rn FROM answers a WHERE a.event_id = #{eventId} AND COALESCE(a.answer_text, a.other_text) IS NOT NULL ) t WHERE t.rn <= #{limit} ORDER BY t.questionId ASC, t.rn ASC
